-- raw up to 2 days, agg_15min beyond, one value per (CET) day beyond 60 days
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
src AS (
  SELECT CASE v.name WHEN 'TEMP_DOWNSTAIRS_C' THEN 'Downstairs' WHEN 'TEMP_OFFICE_C' THEN 'Office' WHEN 'TEMP_KIDROOM_C' THEN 'Kids room' WHEN 'TEMP_DILNA_C' THEN 'Workshop' WHEN 'TEMP_KOLARNA_C' THEN 'Bike shed' WHEN 'TEMP_OUTSIDE_C' THEN 'Outside' ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, max(q.i, v.log_s) AS b
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN raw x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('TEMP_DOWNSTAIRS_C', 'TEMP_OFFICE_C', 'TEMP_KIDROOM_C', 'TEMP_DILNA_C', 'TEMP_KOLARNA_C', 'TEMP_OUTSIDE_C') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE v.name WHEN 'TEMP_DOWNSTAIRS_C' THEN 'Downstairs' WHEN 'TEMP_OFFICE_C' THEN 'Office' WHEN 'TEMP_KIDROOM_C' THEN 'Kids room' WHEN 'TEMP_DILNA_C' THEN 'Workshop' WHEN 'TEMP_KOLARNA_C' THEN 'Bike shed' WHEN 'TEMP_OUTSIDE_C' THEN 'Outside' ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('TEMP_DOWNSTAIRS_C', 'TEMP_OFFICE_C', 'TEMP_KIDROOM_C', 'TEMP_DILNA_C', 'TEMP_KOLARNA_C', 'TEMP_OUTSIDE_C') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b >= 86400 THEN ts - (ts + 3600) % 86400 ELSE ts - ts % b END AS time, name, AVG(value) AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

  WHERE v.name IN ('TEMP_TECHM_BOARD_C', 'TEMP_IOBOARD_D_C', 'TEMP_IOBOARD_U_C', 'TEMP_ELECON_BOARD_C', 'TEMP_BOARD_ELECON_D_C', 'AXPERT_TEMP_C', 'MPPT_TEMP_C', 'TEMP_AKUPACK1_C') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE v.name WHEN 'TEMP_TECHM_BOARD_C' THEN 'TECHM board' WHEN 'TEMP_IOBOARD_D_C' THEN 'IOBOARD down board' WHEN 'TEMP_IOBOARD_U_C' THEN 'IOBOARD up board' WHEN 'TEMP_ELECON_BOARD_C' THEN 'ELECON board' WHEN 'TEMP_BOARD_ELECON_D_C' THEN 'ELECON_D board' WHEN 'AXPERT_TEMP_C' THEN 'Axpert' WHEN 'MPPT_TEMP_C' THEN 'MPPT' WHEN 'TEMP_AKUPACK1_C' THEN 'Workshop battery pack' ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('TEMP_TECHM_BOARD_C', 'TEMP_IOBOARD_D_C', 'TEMP_IOBOARD_U_C', 'TEMP_ELECON_BOARD_C', 'TEMP_BOARD_ELECON_D_C', 'AXPERT_TEMP_C', 'MPPT_TEMP_C', 'TEMP_AKUPACK1_C') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b >= 86400 THEN ts - (ts + 3600) % 86400 ELSE ts - ts % b END AS time, name, AVG(value) AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
